questions.stem: What are the three sub-phases of interphase in the correct order?

options.text: S phase, G1 phase, G2 phase
G1 phase, S phase, G2 phase
G2 phase, S phase, G1 phase
G1 phase, G2 phase, S phase

questions.explanation: Interphase consists of G1 (first growth phase where the cell grows and makes proteins), then S phase (where DNA is replicated), and finally G2 (second growth phase where the cell prepares for division).
